title: Fleet Diagnostic Credit Share Scaled by Twelve-Month Spend — Service Accounts and Repair Orders
content:
**Fleet scaling rule.** On a Service Accounts and Repair Orders commercial fleet account (Commercial Fleet Account - Net 15 or Net 30), the diagnostic credit share follows the account's twelve-month spend and the size of the authorized repair.

| Authorized estimate | Twelve-month spend | Diagnostic credit share |
|---|---|---|
| 1500.00 or more | below 15000.00 | the tier's diagnostic credit share multiplied by the twelve-month spend divided by 15000.00 |
| below 1500.00 | below 15000.00 | the tier's diagnostic credit share multiplied by the authorized estimate divided by 1500.00 |
| any | 15000.00 or more | the tier's diagnostic credit share |

**Terms.**
- The twelve-month spend is the account's customer-pay labor and parts charges dated within the last twelve whole months less the comeback, estimate overage, goodwill and early-payment discount credits dated within those months.
- The authorized estimate is the estimate amount of the latest authorized decision on the diagnosed repair order and concern line.
- A record falls within the last twelve whole months when fewer than twelve whole months separate its date from the day the credit is worked out, a whole month being complete on the same day of a later month, or on the first day of the month after it where that month has no such day, so records dated on that day count.

**Cases (hypothetical, tier share 100%).** Spend 9000.00 and estimate 2100.00 — share 0.6. Spend 9000.00 and estimate 600.00 — share 0.4. Spend 16500.00 — share 1.
